description: The bar chart, Figure 8, illustrates the performance of different Audio-Language models on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Qwen2-Audio-Instruct", "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni", in that order, with no specific scale type indicated. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a model, and the bars within each group colored in different shades of blue, as indicated by the legend, with "MMAU" represented by a darker blue and "MMAR" by a lighter blue. The "MMAU" bars have approximate values of 45, 60, and 65 for "Qwen2-Audio-Instruct", "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni", respectively, while the "MMAR" bars have approximate values of 25, 35, and 55 for the same models. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
